subtopic: Buying and Redeeming Money Market Fund Shares
source_evidence: investors can generally sell their shares back to a money market fund on any business day at the net asset value (NAV) per share.
question: How do investors generally buy and redeem money market fund shares?
answer: Investors buy shares from the fund itself or through a broker for the fund, rather than from other investors on a national securities market. They can generally redeem their shares back to the fund on any business day at the fund’s net asset value (NAV) per share.
